text: Axpo Holding AG is entirely in public hands: all of its shares are owned by the cantons of northeastern Switzerland and the cantonal utilities, with Canton Zürich and its cantonal utility together holding roughly 36% of the shares.
short: Axpo Holding AG is 100% owned by Swiss cantons and their utilities.

source.name: Axpo Group, 'Owners - Entirely in public hands'
source.quote: All of Axpo Holding AG shares are owned by the cantons of Northeastern Switzerland and the cantonal utilities.
source.note: The shareholder table on the same page gives Canton Zürich 18.342% and Elektrizitätswerke des Kantons Zürich 18.410% (together about 36.75%), Canton Aargau and AEW Energie AG about 28%, and the rest with St. Gallerisch-Appenzellische Kraftwerke, EKT Holding, Canton Schaffhausen, Canton Glarus and Canton Zug; the table carries a 19.12.2014 date.
